answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. What survives to the ocean is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A glacier of per-task receipts records who did what, and the relic of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
